candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives all six common inputs and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The second consumes that capsule and reopens anchor_policy and anchor_contract. The third consumes the resulting complete executable state, retains the anchor evidence visibility, and additionally reopens task_constraints and loop_structure. The final call consumes the resulting complete executable closure, retains both prior evidence windows, additionally reopens task and candidate_hypothesis, and emits one policy.
candidate_structure.name: Monotone Evidence-Latch Executable Relay
candidate_structure.organization: four-call sequential lineage carrying one complete executable artifact through cumulatively visible downstream evidence prefixes

calls.objective: Reconcile all initially visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy artifact.
Consume originate_latched_capsule, directly reconcile the inherited complete artifact with the reopened anchor evidence and obligations, and emit one complete executable policy state.

Consume latch_anchor_evidence, retain direct anchor-evidence visibility, add constraints and structural evidence visibility, reconcile their interactions in the inherited complete artifact, and emit one complete executable policy closure.
Consume latch_constraint_evidence, retain both prior evidence windows, add task and hypothesis visibility, reconcile remaining visible obligations in the same complete artifact, and emit one policy.

mode_certificate.scope_boundary: Only downstream common-evidence edge persistence changes; the four-call sequence, single complete executable artifact, nonbranching lineage, and final policy emission remain fixed.
mode_certificate.why_not_repeat_role_fission: No producer, reviewer, finalizer, or additional terminal role is created; the existing lineage positions remain and only their concrete external-evidence visibility changes.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Latch each reopened evidence pair into every later executable transition, producing monotone cumulative visibility while preserving one sequential artifact lineage.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Later calls can directly reconcile interactions between previously reopened and newly reopened obligations without parallel candidates, adjudication, or terminal role fission.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: Disjoint reentry leaves each downstream transition without direct visibility of evidence reopened on earlier transitions, so cross-window obligations survive only through inherited artifact state.

structural_mutation.after: Each downstream call adds one common-evidence window, and every added window remains directly visible on all subsequent lineage edges.
structural_mutation.before: Each downstream call receives one mutually exclusive common-evidence window that disappears at the next lineage edge.
structural_mutation.factor: monotone downstream latching of reentered common evidence
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation changes external-input edge persistence and downstream evidence visibility from disjoint windows to cumulative prefixes while leaving sequence, artifact custody, and call authority intact.

receipt.role: score-blind R84 local_refinement structure architect; never policy code
